line: Crowley's Two of Disks is the card for the first decan of Capricorn, with Jupiter as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: The text names the pair Jupiter and Capricornus; the attribution table reads Jupiter in Capricorn.

quotes.quote: The Two of Pentacles was of old time called the Lord of Harmonious Change.
Its celestial rulers are Jupiter and Capricornus

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: One may in fact consider the card as the picture of the complete manifested Universe
